lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular pixel clusters (blobs) organized in an approximate grid; a specific sub-group of four larger blobs forms a visible rectangular constellation in the central lateral field.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity align with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating anchor nodes at the intersection points across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature characterized by a sharp luminance gradient (light superiorly, shadowed inferiorly) extending longitudinally across the upper-mid section of the visible flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch is present on the trailing edge of the pectoral fin, characterized by a localized loss of pixel data within the fin's macro-mask boundary.
